slides.title:
A terminal you can
talk to.
slides.body: Plain words in. Real commands out. You approve what changes anything.

slides.title: Ask in plain words
slides.body: Answers come from your real files, not a guess.

slides.title:
Wrong name?
It asks, it does not guess.
slides.body: Spelling and typos are forgiven. Nothing is created or opened by mistake.

slides.title: Say "save this as a workflow"
slides.body: It runs the task, then saves what really ran as a .flow file.

slides.title: Double-click to run
slides.body: Cero lists every command and waits for your click.

slides.title: Ctrl+C stops it
slides.body: The request and the command it started, right away.

slides.title: It learns only when you say so
slides.body: Type /learn after a request that worked. Nothing is learned by watching you.

slides.title: Cero
slides.body: macOS, Windows and Linux. The AI runs on your computer.
